summary: Retest of default-site UX bug from previous iteration. Ran full New-Site onboarding wizard as master admin (admin@pulsefitness.com): created site 'QA Retest 1783437831' (Pulse Pro tier, Company Code 200EA3D9) with 3 manually-added equipment items (Treadmill QA A / Bike QA B / Rower QA C, serials SN1783437831A/B/C, £600 total). Logged out, logged in as new owner qaretest1783437831@example.test / OwnerPass123!. On FIRST portal load (/), landing page shows 'Pulse Fitness Pro · QA Retest 1783437831' and Operations → Equipment tab displays ALL 3 equipment items immediately WITHOUT any site switching. No 'No equipment found' message. Site selector shows only ONE site — there is NO separate empty 'Head Office · 0 eq' chip in the header. Bug is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: onboard_pulse_site now flags the newly-created single site as is_head_office=True so GET /sites does NOT auto-create a second empty Head Office. Result: owner lands on the site holding the equipment and sees it immediately.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding → owner portal equipment visibility is fully fixed. Wizard flow: Organisations → Onboarding tab (data-testid consolidated-tab-onboarding) → Onboard Site subtab (onboarding-subtab-site) → click 'New Site' card → Next → Continue (skip invoice upload) → fill onboard-site-name + onboard-postcode → onboard-next → fill Users (input placeholders 'John Smith'/'john@gym.com'/'Min 8 characters') → Next → 'Add Item' x N + fill Manufacturer/Description/Serial/Price → Next → 'Create Site' (data-testid onboard-create). Tier is auto Pro for the New-Site path (no visible tier picker in wizard; the previous spec's onboard-tier-pro id only exists on the tier-picker step used by other paths). Backend URL: https://allocation-wizard-ai.preview.emergentagent.com. Rate limit: wait ~35s between fresh logins to avoid 429.
rca of the issue: Root cause (from previous run): onboard_pulse_site created a child site but GET /sites auto-created an empty Head Office because no site was flagged is_head_office; portal defaulted to that empty HO. Fix (verified this run): onboard_pulse_site now inserts the created site with is_head_office=True, so /api/sites returns exactly one site (the one holding the 3 equipment). Portal owner lands on it and Equipment tab is populated on first load. No manual site switching required. No 'Head Office · 0 eq' entry appears in the header.
